run_reco_game: run a reconstruction game training a Sender and Receiver to communicate attribute-value vectors via CLI
run_discri_game: run a discrimination game training a Sender and Receiver to identify target positions via CLI
run_gumbel_softmax_training: run Gumbel-Softmax training mode with temperature decay for the Sender-Receiver communication game
run_reinforce_training: run Reinforce training mode with entropy regularization for the Sender-Receiver communication game
run_validation_events: run training with print_validation_events flag to log Sender messages and Receiver outputs after training
